question: Trace the claimed background wind to its sources, and test the user's co-varying East Asia, North America east coast and Middle East 500 hPa winds without dismissing seasonal structure as noise.
adva_reference: adva @ 1ecd29b47d216b4e1c482d61a1c3e68252f8a07b; README and docs/TOOLING_WORKFLOW.md; finite external statistical evidence, no native certificate
scope: 1979-2025 cached NCEP/NCAR R1 monthly winds, 500 hPa. Regions confirmed by user; exact boxes below chosen before correlation calculation. January-June 2026 frozen L6/L12 outputs only for descriptive comparison.
source: u500.npz and v500.npz from NOAA monthly uwnd/vwnd NetCDF; raw snapshots rehashed and selected 500 hPa arrays independently reread with xarray before use
primary_observer: S(t)=hypot(area_mean(u),area_mean(v)); speed of regional monthly vector; not mean instantaneous wind speed or gust speed
background_observer: C_m=(mean(u_y,m),mean(v_y,m)) over 1979-2014, then norm. Norm of mean vector differs from mean of norms. Original forecast seasonal background is mean of projected coefficients, reconstructed at requested points.
anomaly_observer: For correlation, remove each series' own 1979-2014 calendar-month means. Use raw physical region u, v and S. S anomalies do not equal norm(vector anomaly).
primary_tests: Three simultaneous regional S anomaly correlations, 1979-2025; report raw and deseasonalized, 1979-2014 and 2015-2025 separately; no automatic strong/weak threshold or causal verdict
secondary_observers: linear detrend fitted only 1979-2014 after deseasonalizing
smaller boxes point +/-5 latitude and +/-10 longitude
area mean of gridpoint vector norms
observed native versus frozen forecast six-month raw and anomaly correlation
uncertainty: 1999 phase-randomized surrogate pairs preserving each full-record anomaly power spectrum, two-sided absolute correlation; Holm correction over three primary S pairs. Null assumes stationary second-order structure and destroys cross-region phase; it is not an atmospheric dynamics model. Independently report all nonzero whole-year circular shifts (46) as a discrete null preserving within-series temporal order and month phase. Approximate 95% percentile confidence interval from 1999 joint moving blocks, block length 24 months; sensitive to stationarity, records and block choice.
calibration: Fixed synthetic common annual cycle plus independent AR anomalies; injected shared AR anomalies; changed held-out values must not affect train seasonal fit. Retain numerical failures. Calibration is finite, not proof of the inference method.
limits: Only 47 years and monthly means; cannot decide synoptic propagation or causality
Same reanalysis family supplies training and diagnostic data; not independent observations
2015-2025 segment was used in prior model development; not a newly untouched test
Six future monthly maps share a fitted model and initial state; no inferential p-values on them
Seasonal phase alignment is real structure and is not random noise
Failure of three simple same-sign speed correlations does not exclude a signed vector or wave-pattern teleconnection
No search over locations or lags this round; exact user-tracked centers may move
stop: One declared analysis and calibrations; allow implementation repairs within three numerical launches, never retune boxes or method to achieve a desired conclusion
